name: expo
description: Develop, Verify, Deploy, and Monitor mobile apps with Expo and React Native.

interface.longDescription:
Develop, Verify, Deploy, and Monitor mobile apps with Expo and React Native. Create screens and navigation, connect APIs, add native features, and troubleshoot or upgrade projects.

Run and inspect your app on an iOS simulator or Android emulator, including cloud devices through Expo Application Services (EAS). Build releases, send beta builds to TestFlight, publish to the App Store and Google Play, deploy web apps, and deliver compatible over-the-air updates. Monitor app performance and update health with EAS Observe and Update Insights.

Includes official Expo guides and tools for projects available to your connected Expo account. Publishing to app stores requires the relevant Apple or Google developer accounts.
